I've answered Tobias in the thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the ticket is **#88412**.

That's the Tier 2 escalation for the Door 6 gatehouse tablet at Tansleigh Packaging, which freezes when scanning the BOL (bill of lading) barcode. Tobias posted it himself in #central-team on 2 July 2025, and he's a member there. I also warned him not to mix it up with #8841, a separate ticket about Door 2 double-booking in the West yard at the Plains depots.
